text: Blockchain based offerings introduce technology risks from code design and functioning and from third party intrusions that are generally absent in traditional offerings, and these risks cannot really be quantified.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110
abstract: Technology-based risks include risks from the design and functioning of code, and from third-party intrusions. Such risks are generally not present in a traditional offering.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: blockchain based offerings compared with traditional offerings
